name: correspondence_type
section:
Note: Correspondence Types
-   Quarterly Paystub Submission
-   Annual HIPP Renewal
-   Information change

You will need to remove previously uploaded old documents before uploading your current documents.

When selecting "Quarterly Paystub Submission" or "Information change" you may be asked "ERASE CURRENT VALUE OF THE FIELD ...?".  Select "OK" each time that this is asked.
label: Correspondence Type
choices: A, New HIPP application | P, Quarterly Paystub Submission | R, Annual HIPP Renewal | C, Information change; any change not reported in the annual renewal or paystub submission. Not applicable for new applications or  applications waiting for approval.

name: heading_1
label:
* * * New HIPP Application * * *
This is a HIPP application. Please answer all questions then, at the bottom, you will be asked to upload the Insurance Plan Summary, an image of each unique insurance card (front and back), your most recent paystub, and a current Employer Insurance Verification form.

Upon submission, your application will enter a queue for analyst review.  Analyst review should occur within one to three business days.  During that time, your application will be locked from further update.

name: heading_2
label:
* * * Annual HIPP Application Renewal * * *
This is an application for renewal. Please verify the following information and make changes where necessary.  At the bottom you will be asked to upload the Insurance Plan Summary, an image of each unique insurance card (front and back), your most recent paystub, and a current Employer Insurance Verification form.

Upon submission, your renewal application will enter a queue for analyst review.  Analyst review should occur within one to three business days.  During that time, your renewal application will be locked from further update.
 &nbsp

name: header_3
label:
* * * Quarterly paystub submission * * *
This is for the upload of your most recent paystub.   Please verify the following information and make changes where necessary.  At the bottom you will need to "Remove" your old paystub and upload your most recent paystub.

Upon submission, your paystub submittal will enter a queue for analyst review.  Analyst review should occur within one to three business days.  During that time, this form will be locked from further update.
 &nbsp

name: heading_4
label:
* * * Change in application information * * *
This form contains the most recent information that you have submitted to DMAS from REDCap.  Please update any changes in your employment or personal demographics, including changes you may have already given to the HIPP analyst over the telephone.  Documents uploaded in the past have been moved into our database; no upload is needed in this change request.

Upon submission, your change submittal will enter a queue for analyst review.  Analyst review should occur within one to three business days.  During that time, this form will be locked from further update.
 &nbsp
